item.title: Chinese AI Chipmakers Poised to Gain From Beijing’s Tech Push
item.author: Bloomberg News

item.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $567 Million Fine by New Mexico Judge
item.author: Eli Tan
item.content:encoded: The penalty, imposed by a state judge, is on top of a $375 million fine ordered by a jury that found Meta misled users about the safety of its platforms.

item.title: BMI's Chowdhury on Copper, Gold, Oil Markets
item.content:encoded: Sabrin Chowdhury, Head of Commodities Research at BMI, discusses the outlook for precious metals and oil markets following reports that Iran attacked “hostile targets” in the Strait of Hormuz. item.title: Jane Street Joins $2 Billion Group With Bet on Australia AI

item.title: Atlassian Shares Surge as Revenue Jump Douses AI Fears

item.title: Markets Slip as Rising Yields Pressure Tech | The Close 8/6/2026
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kestra Investment Management CIO Kara Murphy, e.l.f. Beauty CEO Tarang Amin, Klaviyo CEO & Co-Founder Andrew Bialecki, CAIS Founder, Chairman, & CEO Matt Brown, Manulife John Hancock Investments Co-Chief Investment Strategist Emily Roland, Placer.ai Analytical Research Head R.J. Hottovy, GoodRx CEO Wendy Barnes, Elanco Animal Health President & CEO Jeff Simmons, RXO CEO Drew Wilkerson, & The Conference Board CEO Steve Odland. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Conference Board CEO on C-Suite Optimism, Hiring Plans
item.content:encoded: Steve Odland, CEO of the Conference Board, discussed the latest CEO confidence survey results, which showed an increase from 47 to 52 between the second and third quarters of 2026, moving the index into positive territory. The second quarter's negative reading was largely attributed to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly the war in Iran and the resulting spike in oil prices to around $120 per barrel. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: RXO CEO on Earnings Beat, Freight Market Outlook
item.content:encoded: RXO, a leading freight broker, reported second quarter results showing a 25% increase in revenue and adjusted EPS exceeding analyst estimates by 6 cents. CEO Drew Wilkerson highlighted that the company is in the early stages of a freight recovery, driven by a significant rise in spot rates that currently outperform contract rates. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: CAIS CEO Talks New Funding Round, AI’s Fintech Impact
item.content:encoded: Matt Brown, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of CAIS, discussed the company's recent $170 million Series D funding round led by Vista and supported by Allianz Bernstein, Blue Owl, and Carlyle, which values the alternative asset investment platform at over $2 billion—more than double its previous valuation. Brown highlighted CAIS's 37% organic growth and explained that the new capital will be used to pursue strategic mergers and acquisitions in response to ongoing fintech industry consolidation, enhance AI capabilities to improve the platform's user experience for advisers and asset managers, and provide liquidity to long-term shareholders through an institutional tender offer facilitated by Nasdaq Private Markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Klaviyo CEO on Revenue Growth, E-Commerce Outlook
item.content:encoded: Andrew Bialecki, CEO of Klaviyo, discussed the company's recent financial performance and growth strategy following a quarter with 26% revenue growth, reaching an almost $1.5 billion run rate. Despite a sequential slowdown from previous higher growth rates, Bialecki emphasized the company's durable growth driven by a broad customer base of over 205,000 businesses, including new large clients such as Warner Music Group and the San Francisco 49ers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
